schema_contract.principle: Every candidate requires explicit user confirmation before it becomes durable memory. No auto-adopt.

output_location.note: Both env vars are present in the execution environment. Never hardcode a path such as a specific user's Documents folder. Append new candidates; never overwrite unprocessed ones already in the file.

candidates_md_format.description: candidates.md is a sequence of level-3 markdown headers, one per candidate. Each header is the candidate_id; fields below it are '- 字段: 值' lines.
candidates_md_format.example:
### cand-abc123
- 类型: preference
- 置信度: high
- 摘要: 喜欢先讲原理再举例子，最后才给代码
- 记忆去向: user
- 记忆文本: 沟通风格：先讲原理，再用例子带入，最后才给代码，不堆术语
- 建议字段: 偏好
- 来源: conv-xxxx-turn-3

fields.置信度 (confidence): low | medium | high — evidence strength only, never implies auto-adopt
fields.摘要 (summary): one plain-language sentence shown directly on the review card
fields.记忆去向 (memory_scope): user (→ USER.md, personal profile/preferences) | shared (→ MEMORY.md, broader shared facts)
fields.记忆文本 (memory_text): the exact text that will be written into USER.md/MEMORY.md once confirmed — concise, no raw JSON blobs, no large config dumps
fields.差异 (diff_summary): optional — what changed vs. an existing memory entry, if this updates one
fields.建议字段 (target_field): optional — template field name from the installed role-template field list (e.g. 沟通风格, 工具偏好); leave out when unsure; App preselects it on confirm, user can override
fields.来源 (source_memory_refs): comma-separated source refs (conversation ids / turn ids) so the user can trace where this came from

blocked_items_md_format.description: blocked_items.md is a sequence of level-3 markdown headers, one per blocked item. The header text is the source_ref.
blocked_items_md_format.example:
### mem-with-api-key
- 原因: 内容包含未脱敏的 API Key
- 修复建议: 移除或替换 API Key 后再重新提炼

fields.修复建议 (required_fix): what would need to change for this to become a candidate

candidate_kind_guidance.preference: 喜欢/不喜欢、习惯用什么方式、沟通风格、工具偏好、生活习惯。这是最常见也最应优先识别的一类。
candidate_kind_guidance.instance: 值得记住的人、项目、工具、地点等实体。
candidate_kind_guidance.property: 某个实体的具体特征、设置、配置要点（避免整段原始配置照抄，提炼成一句话）。
candidate_kind_guidance.relation: 实体之间的关联，比如常用某工具做某件事。
candidate_kind_guidance.rule: 摸索出来的经验法则/踩坑教训，通常是 if/then 结构。

memory_scope_guidance.user: 跟用户本人强相关、长期稳定的内容：沟通风格、工具偏好、身份信息、个人习惯。写入 USER.md，容量较小（约 1500 字/16 条），要精炼。
memory_scope_guidance.shared: 更泛化、可能跨项目复用的事实/规则/项目信息。写入 MEMORY.md，容量稍大（约 2500 字/16 条）。

blocked_unless_masked: 他人的身份信息、联系方式等未授权隐私内容
safety_contract.confirmation_mechanism: App 内候选审阅面板；用户点击确认后由 App 后端写入 USER.md/MEMORY.md 并从候选池移除，技能本身不直接触碰这两个文件。
